title: The Cold Village
previously: You were in Grandpa's attic. The old computer pulled you into a game.
Byte is your friend. To go home, you must win the game.
summary: The hero arrives in a cold Viking village. He finds a key under a rock and enters his house. Grandmother says his father is in the forest and needs help. He takes a sword and bread, feeds the hungry wolf on the bridge, and goes into the forest, where he hears his father's voice.
